cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll investigate the missing costume. Start with the wardrobe key. Who had it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did, but the costume was left onstage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your key is irrelevant. Keep to locations. Who cleared the stage?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I put everything in the laundry bags.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Laundry first, then. Don't send anyone after keys. Show me which bag.

reason: Use a backstage search instead of another raffle scene. A makes B's actual answers supply the next questions while correcting B for following A's own earlier emphasis.
